messages:
Sora Cho: Hey everyone — I'm Sora, starting today on Platform. Quick q: which laptop should I pick? macOS with M1 is fine? Also who do I ping for MDM + VPN? Two truths and a lie: I once climbed Kilimanjaro, I can play jazz sax, I'm allergic to chocolate. :)
Avery Lin: welcome Sora! macOS M1 is fine. I'll be your buddy — ping me any time. For MDM/SSH creds, @Morgan (IT) handles that. Also lunchtime sushi tomorrow? :sushi:
Morgan (IT): Hi Sora — sending MDM invite now. Check your email for the enrollment link. VPN host: vpn.redwood-internal.com. If you need SSH keys added, DM me with your GitHub handle. Example VPN command: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o ProxyCommand="nc -x vpn.redwood-internal:1080 %h %p"`
Sora Cho: got the invite! Enrollment failed first try with macOS firewall, turned it off and it worked. Thanks @Morgan. SSH key is sora-cho-gh
Jamal (DevEx): hey Sora — +1 on Avery as buddy. Also here's a short start checklist: 1) MDM enrollment 2) Github access 3) Slack groups (eng, infra, #random) 4) console.redwood.com access. I'll DM a quick links bundle.
Kate (People Ops): Welcome Sora! Onboarding welcome kit is on its way (stickers + ramen coupon :ramen:). New hire orientation at 3pm with me — calendar invite sent. Also, health benefits paperwork link: https://benefits.redwood/hr/onboard
Ben (Platform): FYI, if you're on Platform team, we usually pair on first-week infra runbook read-through. I can schedule a 1:1 tomorrow. Also curious — which of the two truths is the lie? :grin:
Sora Cho: Thanks all — the lie is that I'm allergic to chocolate (sadly true). I did climb Kilimanjaro and I play sax. Looking forward to pairing!
onboard-bot: Reminder — complete security training by EOD Friday. More details in #eng-security.
Avery Lin: welcome again! Slack me when you're free and we'll set up a short walkthrough of our dev loop. Also bring pictures of your dog to #pets :dog:
Sora Cho: will do, thanks everyone!
